agents.name: Warp Factories
agents.quote: Here, we use the Warp Terminal to kick off a run in a Factory and see it update on our web app alongside hundreds of other agent runs from our team.

agents.name: Warp agent
agents.role: in the Warp terminal, for CEO tasks
agents.quote: So, instead of fumbling with the UI, he uses a coding agent in Warp that has access to the Figma MCP (Multi-modal Command Palette).

models.name: GPT 5.6 Sol
models.quote: - Benchmarking models on our own data to find the most efficient cost/performance pick. GPT 5.6 Sol (high) today

history.quote: All 50%+ cheaper than our previous default (Opus 5)

review_style.value: Engineer reviews the agent PR and ships it; QA video attached
review_style.quote: One big change is how we approach code review - for low risk changes, we now let engineers review agent PRs and ship themselves, rather than requiring a second dev’s review.

also.quote: This video is attached to the PR, giving the human reviewer immediate, visual evidence that the feature works as intended.

harness.value: Warp Factories defined in one config file: Slack request, triage, spec, implement, review, QA
harness.quote: We run all of our company's agents out of this configuration file. It's Terraform for agents

mcp_servers.quote: Can you use the Granola MCP to look back over my last four weeks of sales meetings and try to build up a list of the top 10 frequently most asked questions in these meetings as they pertain to Warp software factories?

signature.caption: agents that fix agents
signature.why: Our pick: scorer agents grade every agent run, and other agents turn low scores into PRs that fix the factory's skills.
signature.quote: - Self-improvement agents turn low-scoring conversations into improvements to your agent set up (skills, AGENTS.md, etc)

archetype.why: Designs the agent system and its metrics rather than steering single agents.

signature_quote.value: I'm spending most of my real engineering brainpower at this point architecting how our agent system runs, not guiding individual agents,
